Description: Experiment triggers and detected blinks for the memory task. Onsets reference the "timestamp" column of the corresponding *_physio.tsv.gz.

onset.Description: Event onset within this task segment.

trial_type.Description: Event class (e.g. digit, block_onset, probe, blink).

message.Description: Trigger code. Memory digits use [position][length][correctness], correctness 1=recalled correctly, 0=incorrectly, x=unknown (e.g. 03071 / 03070 / 0307x).
